/system Page Content

For Bobby to build at aheadofmarket.com/system Written by Steve. Last updated: 2026-03-10.

SECTION 1: HERO

Headline: We Built an AI System That Runs Our Business. Now We Build Yours.

Subheadline: Not a chatbot. Not a course. A working operations system that handles email, scheduling, client tracking, outreach, and quality control while you focus on the work that actually makes you money.

SECTION 2: THE PROBLEM

Section title: You're Doing $20/Hour Work on a $200/Hour Schedule

Body:

You run a real business. You're good at what you do. But half your week disappears into admin work that doesn't grow anything.

  • Following up on emails you meant to send three days ago
  • Scheduling and rescheduling the same meeting four times
  • Trying to remember which client needs what by when
  • Posting on social media because you know you should, then going silent for two weeks
  • Losing track of proposals you sent out and never hearing back

You didn't start your business to manage inboxes. But here you are, buried in operations, doing the work of three people because hiring help isn't in the budget yet.

Sound familiar? We know. Because that was us six months ago.

SECTION 3: WHAT WE BUILT

Section title: We Fixed It for Ourselves First

Body:

AOM is a creative production company. We make videos, websites, and brand content for clients. We were drowning in the same operational chaos as every other small business.

So we built a system. Not in theory. For real. It runs every day.

Here's what our AI operations system actually does:

Email Outreach (runs itself) Our outreach agent writes personalized cold emails based on each prospect's actual business, sends them on schedule, and tracks responses. While the founder was on a three-day film shoot, the system sent 12 targeted outreach emails. Zero manual effort.

Calendar Management (plain English) "Block two hours Thursday afternoon for editing." Done. "Move the Friday call to next week." Done. No clicking through menus. Just say what you need.

Multi-Agent Pipeline (specialized AI workers) Instead of one AI doing everything badly, we have specialists:

  • A web developer agent that builds and maintains client websites
  • A brand agent that enforces visual identity across everything
  • A content strategist that plans social media
  • A QA agent that checks every deliverable before a client sees it
  • An operations manager that scans all active projects and flags what needs attention

Each one does its job. They hand work to each other automatically. The founder only steps in to approve or redirect.

Quality Control (nothing ships without inspection) Every deliverable runs through a quality gate before anyone sees it. Broken links, slow load times, design issues, copy errors. Caught and fixed before they become client problems.

Mobile Command Center The founder runs the entire system from his phone via Telegram. On set? In a meeting? Driving? Doesn't matter. Full visibility and control from anywhere.

Institutional Memory Every decision gets logged. Priorities update automatically. The system remembers what happened last Tuesday so you don't have to. No more "wait, didn't we already decide that?"

SECTION 4: REAL RESULTS (not hypothetical)

Section title: This Is What Happened Last Week

Bobby to format these as cards/callouts:

  • 12 personalized outreach emails sent while the founder was on a film set. Each one referenced the prospect's actual business. Not mail merge. Real personalization.

  • 2 client websites built and QA'd without the founder writing a single line of code. The web agent built them, the QA agent tested them, issues were caught and fixed before anyone saw them.

  • Zero dropped balls on a 6-client workload. The operations agent scans every active project daily and flags anything falling behind. Nothing slips through the cracks.

  • Calendar managed entirely by voice. Editing blocks, client calls, production days, team schedules. All handled through natural language. No assistant needed.

  • Brand consistency enforced automatically. Every visual deliverable checked against brand standards before it ships. Font sizes, contrast ratios, spacing, color accuracy. The QA agent is pickier than any human reviewer.

SECTION 5: THE GAP

Section title: Enterprise Gets This. You Don't. Until Now.

Body:

Big companies spend $200,000+ on AI consultants from McKinsey or Deloitte. They get custom systems, dedicated teams, and ongoing support.

Small business owners? You get YouTube tutorials and $500 online courses that teach you how to write better ChatGPT prompts. That's it. Nobody's actually building working systems for businesses your size.

Here's the landscape:

Enterprise AI Consulting Online Courses / DIY AOM
Cost $50,000 - $500,000+ $0 - $500 $2,500 - $8,000
What you get Custom system, dedicated team Videos, templates, "figure it out" Working system, built for your business
Who it's for Fortune 500 Hobbyists, solopreneurs Real businesses, 5-50 employees
Timeline 6-12 months Self-paced (forever) 2-4 weeks

That gap in the middle? That's where 99% of businesses live. That's where we operate.

SECTION 6: WHO THIS IS FOR

Section title: Built for Businesses Like Yours

Body:

This is for small service businesses doing $500K to $5M in revenue who are running on grit and spreadsheets. Contractors. HVAC companies. Law firms. Dental practices. Real estate teams. Nonprofits. Creative agencies.

You have revenue. You have clients. You don't have a back-office team.

You're the owner, the salesperson, the project manager, the bookkeeper, and the social media manager. All at once. And something is always falling through the cracks.

We know because we are you. AOM's founder built this system because he was tired of being all five of those people. It worked. Now we build it for others.

SECTION 7: THE OFFER

Section title: AI Operations Audit

Price: $2,500 flat

Body:

We spend two weeks understanding how your business actually runs. Not how you wish it ran. How it runs today. Then we hand you a written report that shows you exactly where AI saves you real time.

What's included:

  1. Discovery session (2-3 hours). We walk through your daily operations with you. Where do you spend time? What falls through the cracks? What do you wish someone else handled?

  2. Operations mapping. We document your workflows: how leads come in, how clients get managed, how work gets delivered, how follow-ups happen (or don't).

  3. AI opportunity analysis. We identify every place where an AI system can take work off your plate. Not theory. Specific, practical recommendations based on your actual business.

  4. Written report with prioritized recommendations. What to automate first. What the expected time savings are. What it would take to build. Clear, plain English. No jargon.

  5. Walkthrough call. We present the findings, answer your questions, and help you decide what to do next.

The math is simple. If you're worth $100/hour to your business and we find 10 hours a week of automatable work, you recoup your $2,500 investment in less than three weeks. Everything after that is time and money back in your pocket.

SECTION 8: WHY AOM

Section title: We're Not Consultants. We're Operators.

Body:

Most AI consultants have never run a business. They studied AI. We run a company with it.

AOM is a working creative production company. We serve real clients. We hit real deadlines. The AI system we're offering to build for you? We use it ourselves, every single day. When we say "this saves you 10 hours a week," it's because it saved us 10 hours a week first.

Patrik Matheson, AOM's founder, built this system for himself. Not because he's a technologist. Because he was drowning in admin work and needed a way out. He found it. Now he helps other business owners find theirs.

We're the proof of concept.

SECTION 9: CTA

Headline: Let's Find Your 10 Hours

Body: Book a free 15-minute call. We'll talk about what's eating your time and whether an AI operations audit makes sense for your business. No pitch. No pressure. Just a real conversation with someone who gets it.

Button: Talk to Us

Note for Bobby: Route this CTA through the same Talk to Us overlay/intake flow used on the main site. If there's a way to tag the lead source as "system page," do that.

SECTION 10: SOCIAL PROOF / TRUST (optional, add when ready)

When we have audit clients and testimonials, add them here. For now, the proof is the system itself. Consider adding:

  • A live counter or visual showing what the system processed today/this week (if technically feasible)
  • A short video of Patrik demoing the system from his phone (30-60 seconds, shot casually)

DESIGN NOTES FOR BOBBY

  • Same design system as the rest of aheadofmarket.com. Dark Frame aesthetic, Steffen's brand specs.
  • High contrast, big readable text. "Old people can read em, young people love em."
  • The agent pipeline section (Section 3) could benefit from a visual diagram. Think: icons or cards for each agent with arrows showing the flow. Keep it clean, not cluttered.
  • The comparison table (Section 5) should be visually distinct. Make AOM's column pop.
  • Real results section (Section 4) works best as cards or callouts with bold stats.
  • Mobile-first. Business owners will see this on their phones.
  • No stock photos. If we need visuals, use screenshots of the actual system or nothing.
